hero_picker_name_prompt_default: ...And what do you want me to call you?
hero_picker_quote_fallback: Oh shoot, here we go again!
hero_picker_unavailable_hint: Check backend is running and GET /characters returns active rows.

profile_change_name_body: This is how you appear to other players in lobbies and games. Choose a nickname of up to 12 characters.
bonus_round_desc: In this round we won't show the question everyone answered. Keep your question secret — no one will know for sure they're not the impostor. Only the results and who voted for whom will be shown. Think harder before you vote!
tutorial_pass_around_1: Each player takes the phone, reads their question, types their answer, then hands it off.
tutorial_pass_around_3: And if you peek — you're the real villain here.
tutorial_twist_1: Most of you got the same question, but one of you got a different one.
tutorial_twist_2: You think you're answering the same thing... then the question is revealed.
tutorial_twist_3: That's when the odd one realizes 'Oh, no, it's me!'
tutorial_accuse_1: You've got time to call each other out - point at people, overanalyze, yell 'YOU!' dramatically, the whole deal.
tutorial_accuse_2: When the timer ends, vote for the impostor.
tutorial_accuse_3: Trust no one. Or make them all trust you!
round_start_hint: Click START once the phone is in your hands.
results_bonus_no_question: We're not showing the shared question. Keep yours secret — anyone could be the impostor!
results_who_voted_whom: Who voted for whom? Discuss, then vote.
discussion_chat_hint: Talk it out around the table — live chat between phones can be added later.
referral_login_hint: Log in to get your referral link
referral_login_sub: Sign in with Google or Apple to invite friends and unlock rewards.
referral_error: Could not load referral data. Pull to refresh.
heroes_error_hint: Check backend is running and GET /characters returns active rows.
loading_hint: Hang tight, we're getting everything ready.
click_next_phone: Click NEXT once the phone is in your hands and nobody is looking
hand_phone_next: Hand the phone to next player
pass_device_sub: Hand the phone to next player
name_min_letters: Name must be at least 3 letters
htp_gather_1: Get your friends together — in one room or on a quick call or video chat.
htp_gather_2: You'll need to talk, bluff, and overanalyze everything.
htp_question_1: Each player gets a question — except one who secretly gets a *different* one.
htp_question_2: That person is the Impostor… but even they don't know it yet! Everyone answers truthfully — no lying yet!
htp_discuss_1: All answers appear. Talk, argue, defend, and accuse.
htp_discuss_2: This is when the Impostor finally sees the real question — and realizes it's them. Now they must blend in… or fake it till they make it.
htp_vote_1: When time's up, everyone votes who they think the Impostor is.
htp_vote_2: Votes are revealed — but the suspense stays until the end! Did you catch it?
htp_reveal_1: The true Impostor is revealed — and so is their secret question!
htp_reveal_2: Laugh, scream, or cry — depends on how well you guessed.
htp_reveal_3: Then brace yourself for a new round of chaos.
